headline: HUD and Mod Improvements
summary: More control over your HUD, clearer mod settings, and support for bundled resource and behavior packs.

items.text: Manage individual HUD elements and align them with grid, element, and screen-center snapping.
Move the HUD Editor panel out of the way using its drag handle.
Gyro and Hotbar Slot Button settings are now organized into clearer categories.
Mods can now bundle resource and behavior packs for the launcher to install automatically.
